page_title: PSG 4-1 LYO | PSG v Lyon 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's it for today, Francois Letexier has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Carlos Soler (PSG) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90+1' Malick Fofana (Lyon) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
89' Vitinha (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
88' Mama Balde (Lyon) tackles a bit over-zealously and Francois Letexier blows for a foul.
87' PSG enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

83' Mama Balde (Lyon) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies low towards the middle of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Gianluigi Donnarumma.
82' Kang-In Lee (PSG) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
81' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Kang-In Lee (PSG) replaces Goncalo Ramos.
80' Mama Balde (Lyon) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lyon comes to nothing.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Malick Fofana (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Ernest Nuamah.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Cherki leaves the pitch and Mama Balde (Lyon) comes on.
77' Here is a change. Warren Zaire-Emery is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Soler (PSG).
77' Here comes a substitution. Achraf Hakimi is given a rest as he is replaced by Nordi Mukiele (PSG).

76' Gift Orban (Lyon) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.
75' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) tries to find Goncalo Ramos, but he puts too much power on the pass.
73' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
71' Referee Francois Letexier sees the trip by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
68' Substitution. Nemanja Matic makes way for Corentin Tolisso (Lyon).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gift Orban (Lyon) replaces Alexandre Lacazette.
68' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Bradley Barcola is replaced by Senny Mayulu (PSG).
68' Marquinhos comes off the pitch to be replaced by Milan Skriniar (PSG).
67' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) and Goncalo Ramos combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
66' Some patient build-up play from PSG as they look to unlock the defence.
65' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
65' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
64' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off a great save to deny Maxence Caqueret (Lyon), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.

62' Bradley Barcola (PSG) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
62' Clinton Mata (Lyon) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Francois Letexier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. PSG are awarded the free kick.
60' Total attempts – 13:12. The current number of shots on goal is 5:4.
59' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) obviously dived.
58' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
56' The linesman signals that Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
56' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

55' Great save! Rayan Cherki (Lyon) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma. Lyon earn a corner.
55' Bradley Barcola (PSG) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the right post.
53' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
51' Marco Asensio (PSG) takes a short corner kick.

51' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, PSG are awarded a corner kick.
50' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
50' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
50' The ball is cleared after Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Pierre Sage makes a switch. Clinton Mata is coming on in place of Said Benrahma (Lyon) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Francois Letexier who sees an offensive foul.
45+2' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

45+1' Said Benrahma (Lyon) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The referee points to the corner flag and Lyon will take a corner.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Lyon will take a throw-in.
44' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' 4 - 1 It's 4:1! Marco Asensio feeds Goncalo Ramos (PSG) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
41' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) plays a through ball but overhits it.
39' CLOSE! Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!

37' 3 - 1 What a spectacular moment! Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) skips past defenders and finds some space before blasting a long-range strike at goal. The fans are amazed when they see the ball go into the bottom right corner. The scoreline is 3:1.
34' Achraf Hakimi plays a lovely pass into Bradley Barcola (PSG), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post.

32' 3 - 0 Achraf Hakimi showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom left corner. It's 3:0.
31' The corner is swung in but PSG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
30' Marco Asensio (PSG) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and PSG will have a corner.
29' Bradley Barcola (PSG) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
26' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
25' The ball is out of play. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner.

24' Great save! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
23' PENALTY APPEAL after Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
22' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
21' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) picks up an injury.

20' Said Benrahma (Lyon) whips the ball into the box and Alexandre Lacazette takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
17' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.

14' Bradley Barcola (PSG) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Anthony Lopes thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
10' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.
7' Now Lyon have a corner.
6' 2 - 0 GOAL - 2:0! The corner comes over and Bradley Barcola flicks on with his head to Lucas Beraldo (PSG), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
6' PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Lyon failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
3' 1 - 0 Oh, what an awful moment for Nemanja Matic (Lyon). He was trying to clear a dangerous pass to safety from inside the box, but sent the ball into his own net.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Francois Letexier.
